data.description:
# Audit runner: clear assignee on terminal verdicts, preserve completed/in_review on failure

Mirrors ContextHub epic child WL-0MV85WE7Q00044P9 (epic WL-0MV82CHGQ000HAZZ) per the producer decision on root-cause bug WL-0MV7W77AY005MGBL (cross-repo change authorised via an SA item). Under Option A the audit-tier claim is status-neutral (assignee CAS), so the runner must clear the assignee on every terminal verdict path and must never coerce a review-queue item to plan_complete.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] On the success ('yes') verdict path the runner clears the assignee, retains completed/in_review, and applies the producer hold required by policy (assign to the producer sentinel rather than the retired needsProducerReview flag).
- [ ] On the failure-restore path the runner restores completed/in_review and clears the assignee — the inlined `_STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT` coercion of `in_review → plan_complete` is no longer reachable for review-queue items.
- [ ] The SIGKILL abort-recovery (state-file) path restores completed/in_review and clears the assignee.
- [ ] On the 'no' verdict path the runner clears the assignee.
- [ ] Unit + integration tests cover each terminal path, including captured-pre-audit-state = status-neutral-claim case.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py`
- `skill/audit/scripts/tests/` (unit + integration tests)

## Related work

- ContextHub WL-0MV85WE7Q00044P9 (epic child, delivery mirror)
- ContextHub WL-0MV82CHGQ000HAZZ (epic)
- ContextHub WL-0MV7W77AY005MGBL (root-cause bug)
- Producer-hold sentinel `PRODUCER_HOLD_ASSIGNEE = 'Map'` defined in ContextHub `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` (WL-0MV85WDOM007BKF8, epic Q2)
